cases.name: etaf-mario-campaign-is-healthy
cases.purpose: All four bundled levels parse, every floating block leaves room to pass, and every sprite character has a colour in every theme.

cases.name: etaf-mario-levels-keep-two-empty-rows-under-floating-blocks
cases.purpose: No shipped block leaves a one-row shelf that big Mario cannot walk under and the player cannot jump through.

cases.name: etaf-mario-jump-bumps-the-block-above
cases.purpose: Jumping under a question block turns it into a used block and pays its coin.

cases.name: etaf-mario-bumped-coin-pop-leaves-the-world
cases.purpose: A coin popped from a bumped block finishes its animation and leaves the entity list instead of lingering as a walker.

cases.name: etaf-mario-jump-collects-a-coin-tile
cases.purpose: A jump through a floating coin collects it, clears the tile and increases the coin counter.

cases.name: etaf-mario-big-mario-passes-under-a-floating-shelf
cases.purpose: Big Mario walks beneath a three-block-high block run without hitting a wall or losing power.

cases.name: etaf-mario-pit-ends-the-run
cases.purpose: Walking off the first sky platform falls into the pit and starts the death sequence.

cases.name: etaf-mario-render-joins-adjacent-blocks
cases.purpose: A run of adjacent blocks draws a single outer border instead of repeating a frame around every tile.

cases.name: etaf-mario-render-joins-both-pipe-halves
cases.purpose: A two-block-wide pipe draws one rim and one pair of body edges with no seam between its halves.

cases.name: etaf-mario-render-keeps-feet-on-the-ground
cases.purpose: The player's last sprite row sits directly on the grass row, bottom aligned with the block grid.

cases.name: etaf-mario-render-aligns-enemies-on-their-platform
cases.purpose: Enemies spawned on sky platforms stand exactly on the platform's top edge.

cases.name: etaf-mario-render-keeps-pits-as-gaps
cases.purpose: Both ground rows stay empty in a pit, and the grass surface resumes at the pit edge.

cases.name: etaf-mario-camera-scrolls-one-cell-at-a-time
cases.purpose: During a steady walk the camera and the player's screen column advance by at most one character cell per simulation step.
